question: During photosynthesis the oxygen in glucose comes from ______.

options.text: Both from water and carbon dioxide

solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbon dioxide**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Photosynthesis is the physiochemical process, in which carbohydrates (organic compounds) are formed from inorganic substrates like H₂O & CO₂ in the presence of light and pigments.
 
• O₂ is evolved as a by-product during photosynthesis.
 
• The **oxygen molecule present in glucose is derived from carbon dioxide** during **Calvin cycle of photosynthesis**.
 
• The CO₂ molecule is first added to 3-phosphoglycerate during the carboxylation reaction of Calvin cycle, and is later used to form glucose.
 
• While molecular oxygen that is liberated during photosynthesis is produced from photolysis of water during the light reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Photosynthesis can be simply divided into 4 major processes

 
• Absorption of light energy by **Chlorophyll pigment.**
 
• Conversion of light energy into chemical energy.
 
• **Splitting of water or Photolysis** during Non-cyclic photophosphorylation.

** H₂O → 2H⁺ + 2e⁻⁻ + [IMAGE: file:///C:/Users/utkar/AppData/Local/Temp/OICE_7537A668-6D1D-4E05-8EA6-84C3B2569657.0/msohtmlclip1/01/clip_image004.png] O₂ **↑

**The oxygen that evolved during this process comes from water__**.

 
• **Reduction of CO₂ to carbohydrates (Glucose) during Dark reaction.**

**​**The CO2 undergoes reduction and its O2 is utilized in the formation of Glucose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

The **O₂ released during photolysis is the evolved O₂**, whereas **the O₂ released during the reduction of CO₂ is the O₂ in glucose.**
